cross_run_checks.pooling_warning: The six models share the same 128 cases. They are six correlated paired comparisons, not 768 independent examples.

multiplicity.bootstrap_caveat: The reported 95% percentile intervals are unadjusted, discrete, approximate within-model intervals. A positive lower endpoint can coexist with a two-sided exact McNemar p above 0.05; they are not the same test and do not establish a multiplicity-controlled gain.
